list.query: select distinct coalesce(service_group, '(none)') from control.instance_inventory where is_active order by 1
list.name: service_group
list.label: Service Group

list.query: select display_name as __text, instance_pk::text as __value from control.instance_inventory where is_active and (coalesce(service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) order by display_name
list.name: instance
list.label: Instance

list.query: select distinct datname as __text, datname as __value from dim.database_ref where not is_template and (instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) order by datname
list.name: database
list.label: Database

targets.rawSql: with latest as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk) select count(*) as "Active Connections" from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join latest l on l.instance_pk = a.instance_pk and l.ts = a.snapshot_ts join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where a.state = 'active' and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring}))

with latest as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk) select count(*) as "Idle in Tx" from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join latest l on l.instance_pk = a.instance_pk and l.ts = a.snapshot_ts join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where a.state = 'idle in transaction' and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring}))

select case when coalesce(sum(d.session_time_ms_delta), 0) = 0 then 0 else round((coalesce(sum(d.idle_in_transaction_time_ms_delta), 0)::numeric / nullif(sum(d.session_time_ms_delta), 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) end as "Idle Tx %" from fact.pg_database_delta d join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = d.instance_pk where d.sample_ts >= now() - interval '1 hour' and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) and (d.datname in (${database:sqlstring}))

with latest as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk) select a.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, count(*) filter (where a.state is not null) as open, count(*) filter (where a.state = 'active') as active, count(*) filter (where a.state = 'idle') as idle, count(*) filter (where a.state = 'idle in transaction') as idle_in_tx, round(count(*) filter (where a.state = 'idle in transaction')::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where a.state is not null), 0) * 100, 1) as idle_tx_pct from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join latest l on l.instance_pk = a.instance_pk and l.ts = a.snapshot_ts join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) group by a.instance_pk, i.display_name order by idle_tx_pct desc

with latest as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk) select a.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, a.pid, coalesce(a.usename, '') as usename, coalesce(a.application_name, '') as application_name, a.state, round(extract(epoch from (l.ts - coalesce(a.state_change, l.ts)))) as idle_seconds from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join latest l on l.instance_pk = a.instance_pk and l.ts = a.snapshot_ts join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where a.state = 'idle in transaction' and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) order by idle_seconds desc limit 50

with samples as (select $__timeGroup(a.snapshot_ts, $__interval) as bucket, a.instance_pk, max(a.snapshot_ts) as snapshot_ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where $__timeFilter(a.snapshot_ts) and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) group by 1, a.instance_pk), activity as (select s.bucket as time, a.state from samples s join fact.pg_activity_snapshot a on a.instance_pk = s.instance_pk and a.snapshot_ts = s.snapshot_ts) select time, metric, value from (select time, coalesce(state, 'unknown') as metric, count(*) as value from activity group by time, coalesce(state, 'unknown') union all select time, 'open' as metric, count(*) filter (where state is not null) as value from activity group by time) x order by time
